unsafe base.
Map = use "std/map".
Meters = Type (Meters Int).
fill n m = if n <= 0 then m else fill (n - 1) (Map.insert n (Meters n) m).
addValue a key value = case value of Meters x -> a + x.
check n = m = fill n Map.ints; a = Map.fold addValue 0 m; Map.fold addValue a m.
main = case Sys.args Unit of ["large"] -> print (check 512) | _ -> print (check 128).
